Mission Local reported in 2016 that Rec & Park was ending paid lawn reservations at Dolores Park after controversy over a lawn-rental pilot. The change limited reservations to picnic tables; the department said lawn reservations would be suspended. The story also noted that permit fees help offset cleanup costs.
